claims.claim: The model can distinguish authentic vs fake examples for the five trained brands when the caller declares one of those brands. This is classification within the evaluated scope, not image-level brand identification.
claims.label: SUPPORTED_WITH_SCOPE
claims.scope: In-distribution final test of 3006 images across the five training brands. The brand is user-declared. The model does not verify that the image belongs to that brand.

claims.claim: The model is a general luxury-watch authenticity detector.
claims.label: NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.scope: The catalog and the final test contain five brands. Phase 35 showed high authentic escape on other watches.

claims.claim: The model can safely reject unseen watch brands.
claims.label: NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.scope: Phase 35 unseen-luxury authentic escape was 171/194. Phase 36 had 14 unseen-luxury holdout images and is unresolved.

claims.claim: The model is protected against OOD inputs.
claims.label: NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.scope: Phase 35 status is OOD_FAIL. production_ood_threshold is null. 337/408 OOD images were AUTHENTIC under the no-OOD-gate shadow rule.

claims.claim: The model is suitable for production customer traffic.
claims.label: NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.scope: Promotion is forbidden. The live serving path is DINOv2. The frozen candidate is DINOv3 and is not the customer path.

claims.claim: The model has demonstrated zero false-authentic errors.
claims.label: SUPPORTED_WITH_SCOPE
claims.scope: Zero false-authentic counts on the locked five-brand final test and on the tested stress suite. This does not extend outside that evaluated scope.

claims.claim: The model has demonstrated zero false-authentic errors on the full luxury-watch universe.
claims.label: NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.scope: The universe was not tested. Phase 35 is evidence against treating in-distribution zeros as universal.

claims.claim: The model's five-brand final test achieved perfect classification.
claims.label: SUPPORTED_WITH_SCOPE
claims.scope: Calibrated ROC-AUC, PR-AUC, and F1 are 1.0 on 3006 locked in-distribution samples. This is not evidence of universal luxury-watch authenticity.

claims.label: SUPPORTED_WITH_SCOPE
claims.scope: One temperature, 0.24038200410185356, was fitted on 2998 in-distribution calibration samples. It was not fitted on OOD images and was not refit here.

claims.label: NOT_SUPPORTED
claims.scope: Phase 34 was CONDITIONALLY_READY and not promoted. OOD, runtime parity, serving infrastructure, and policy approval remain open. Phase 38 recommended scope reduction.

five_brand_classification_meaning: Classification of authentic versus fake within the five evaluated brands after a user declaration. It is not brand identification.
